confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
verified_facts: EA describes the 2022 1m Composite DTM as bare-earth raster elevation covering about 99% of England.
It merges Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys; repeat areas use the newest best-resolution source and resampling can use bilinear interpolation.
EA directs users to metadata index catalogues to identify which source survey contributed at a location.
semantic_limits: 1m spatial resolution is not parcel-specific vertical accuracy.
The composite cannot establish target survey lineage until an exact metadata feature is matched.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: National LIDAR Programme
verified_facts: EA states the National LIDAR Programme provides 1m elevation data across England.
Phase 1 divided England into 302 blocks captured between 2017 and February 2023, with later repeat surveys assigned incrementing phase numbers.
semantic_limits: Programme phase is not the same as the exact source survey for a composite pixel.
Current programme coverage does not establish historical parcel lineage without metadata matching.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return DSM - 1m
verified_facts: EA states the first-return DSM includes buildings, vegetation, vehicles and terrain where the first/only return is ground.
The 2022 composite is built from National LIDAR Programme surveys and uses overlap feathering.
semantic_limits: First-return DSM is excluded from bare-earth parcel extrema.
Feathered DSM agreement is not an independent DTM validation.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return DSM - 2m
verified_facts: EA describes the 2m first-return DSM as an object-inclusive elevation surface derived from National LIDAR Programme surveys.
The product uses overlap feathering across survey blocks.
semantic_limits: 2m first-return DSM is not a bare-earth DTM source.
Its coarser resolution and object content prevent use for parcel min/max terrain values.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Known Data Issues
verified_facts: OS maintains a dedicated current known-data-issues page for Terrain 5.
The current page reports no live known data issues at the time checked.
semantic_limits: No listed live issue does not prove a target tile is error-free.
Issue-page status is product QA context, not parcel accuracy evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Known Data Issues
verified_facts: OS maintains a dedicated known-data-issues page for Terrain 50.
The current page reports no live known data issues at the time checked.
semantic_limits: Absence of listed issues is not a per-tile validation.
Terrain 50 remains coarse secondary evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Downloads
verified_facts: OS publishes Terrain 5 supporting XML schemas for contour, grid and viewing-style metadata.
Product acquisition is routed through the OS Data Hub.
semantic_limits: Schema availability is not a terrain observation.
Different encodings of the same product do not provide independent evidence.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Downloads
verified_facts: OS publishes Terrain 50 XML schema resources for contour and gridded products and viewing-style metadata.
semantic_limits: Schema files describe encoding and do not create independent measurements.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 Overview
verified_facts: OS describes Terrain 5 as a mid-resolution bare-earth DTM and publishes product accuracy context based on GPS sample comparisons.
Terrain 5 is updated quarterly.
semantic_limits: Product RMSE context is not parcel-specific uncertainty.
Terrain 5 remains secondary to EA DTM1m in this workflow.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Overview
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 has regular 50m grid spacing and is updated annually in July.
OS states Terrain 50 grid data has been verified to 4m RMSE.
semantic_limits: 4m RMSE is product-level verification, not parcel-specific error.
50m spacing makes Terrain 50 a coarse cross-check only.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 source data
verified_facts: OS states Terrain source data is captured as a TIN using mass points/breaklines and photogrammetric methods.
Grid and contour forms are interpolated from that same TIN, and source z values have geographic-class accuracy requirements relative to Newlyn Datum or local island datums.
semantic_limits: Source-TIN requirements are not the same as published parcel accuracy.
Grid and contour agreement is correlated because both derive from the same TIN.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 5 product glossary
verified_facts: OS defines accuracy as closeness of observations, computations or estimates to accepted true values.
semantic_limits: A glossary definition is semantic context only and cannot supply a parcel uncertainty value.

candidates.name: Practice guide 40 overview
verified_facts: The official overview routes title-plan work across supplements covering OS mapping basis, application plans, boundaries, determined boundaries and title plans.
semantic_limits: Guide routing is provenance context, not exact parcel geometry or terrain evidence.

candidates.name: Basis of HM Land Registry plans publication
verified_facts: HMLR states the supplement explains origins/scales of Ordnance Survey mapping and how they relate to Land Registry plans.
semantic_limits: Publication metadata is not parcel geometry evidence.

candidates.name: Basis of Land Registry plans - practice guide 40 supplement 1
verified_facts: HMLR states OS mapping shows topographic features and is not intended to represent property boundaries.
Typical title-plan mapping scales are 1:1250 urban, 1:2500 rural and 1:10000 mountain/moorland.
semantic_limits: Mapping scale is cartographic context, not a legal-boundary tolerance or terrain-height accuracy.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans practice guides collection
verified_facts: The official collection currently lists PG40 supplements including boundaries updated 1 June 2026 and title plan updated 13 July 2026.
semantic_limits: Collection freshness is provenance context only.
